# Sagar Lad

> Author, investor, and educator. I write about data engineering, cloud architecture, career growth, and mindset.

Sagar Lad is a personal website and blog where the author shares practical frameworks on data engineering, cloud architecture, career growth, investing, and mindset. The site includes a blog with articles, books written by the author, videos, mentoring, and a newsletter.

## Key topics

- Data & Cloud — Azure, Databricks, data engineering, modern data architecture
- Career & Growth — failure, purpose, productivity, morning routines
- Mindset & Awareness — the MIND UP framework, emotional alignment, resilience
- Investing & Finance — wealth building, financial awareness
